mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wx_callback_route (uuid, callback_url, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{callbackUrl}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE callback_url = VALUES(callback_url), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, callback_url, create_time, update_time FROM wx_callback_route WHERE uuid = #{uuid} LIMIT 1
